senses.gloss: m. (Parel of בסם, cmp. בַּלְסָם) a dripping like balsam, whence catarrh of the head.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 105b">Ḥull. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>קשי לב׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לכ׳</he>, Mus. <cite ref="K01248"><he>כרסום</he></cite>) is liable to produce catarrh; <he>לב׳ דחמרא וכ׳</he> a remedy for a catarrh contracted from drinking the foam of wine, is beer; for thet from beer &c.—
Gitt. 69ᵃ לב׳ a remedy for &c. [Ar.: pleurisy. Pers. ברסאם, v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, p. 228ᵇ.]
